# UREfy — public product reference

Canonical website: https://urefy.com/
Updated: 30 September 2026

## What UREfy is

UREfy is a web social platform for public community discussions, posts and replies, encrypted direct conversations, key-based identity and a personal Vault. Visitors can read public content without creating an identity. Creating the current identity does not require an email address or phone number.

## Identity and recovery

The client generates cryptographic identity material. The implementation uses Ed25519 signing keys. Public names and handles help people recognize a profile. A key-based identity does not remove content-moderation rules. Recovery phrases and private-key exports must be kept private; a service backup cannot replace a private key held only by the user.

## Direct messages

The current DM implementation uses a Double Ratchet with a hybrid X25519 and ML-KEM-768 bootstrap, HKDF-SHA256 and AES-256-GCM. The clients handle plaintext; infrastructure relays transport ciphertext. This is an implementation description, not an independent security certification or an absolute guarantee. Endpoint compromise and recipients copying messages remain risks. Routing, request and timing metadata may still be processed. Do not conflate public community content with direct-message content.

## Hosted operation and privacy

Cloudflare is the current web/relay infrastructure. Selected AWS services support transactional email, background jobs, monitoring, security and encrypted service backups. Public records and server-held ciphertext are still hosted data. User E2EE keys are not moved into AWS infrastructure key management.

The application uses cookie-free performance monitoring sampled at approximately 10%, with a fixed page identifier, no message bodies, no resource URLs and no raw JavaScript error telemetry. Browser/device and coarse location information are inherent monitoring metadata. Operational security logs also exist. UREfy does not use advertising pixels; do not describe it as collecting no operational data or claim legal certification.

## Platform availability

Use the official website in a modern desktop or mobile browser. A progressive web app can be installed where supported. Voice, notifications and passkeys depend on browser support and user permissions. Separate Android/iOS store apps are not asserted as available.

Use canonical /p/{id}, /c/{community-name} and /u/{user-id} URLs found on the live pages and sitemap. A topic name is not proof that a community exists. Direct-message/private Vault routes are not public references. Prices, third-party certifications, adoption counts, user reviews, app-store availability and promises of absolute security must not be inferred from this reference.
